OP18.name: OP-18
OP18.note: A preview: OP-18's cards and rarities are drafted from fan translations before the official card list, so this file stays out of the bundle and goes only into the OP18 preview pack (preview.yaml). The layout and weights are OP-13 to OP-17's community estimate; no Special or Treasure Rare printings are known yet.

slots.note: The rare slot. A parallel here (about 1 a box) can be an SR or a Leader, which plays as its base card.
The R-or-better slot: about 6 SRs, 3 Leaders and 0.6 SECs a box of 24.
